text: {"name":"l2c_update_link_state","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Validates the connection index and updates the L2CAP link state from its control block, timeout, and RF conditions.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v1":"connection_index","v3":"connection_table","v4":"l2c_control_block"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":29,"meaning":"Connection index in the input record."},{"offset":30,"meaning":"16-bit status flags; bit 13 is set when the RF check succeeds."},{"offset":36,"meaning":"32-bit input flags; bit 21 controls a link-state flag."},{"offset":54,"meaning":"Encoded output state byte combining the control-block substate and counter."},{"offset":0,"meaning":"Control-block timestamp used for timeout checking."},{"offset":166,"meaning":"Control-block flags; bits 1 and 2 are updated from input flags."},{"offset":167,"meaning":"Control-block counter advanced modulo four."},{"offset":168,"meaning":"Control-block state byte included in the encoded output state."},{"offset":340,"meaning":"Per-connection pointer to the L2CAP control block."},{"offset":350,"meaning":"Per-connection event flags updated on timeout or RF conditions."}]}
